extra.summary: The UOB One Card is best for those diligent about hitting specific monthly spending tiers (S$600, S$1,000, or S$2,000) to unlock the highest cashback rates. The up to 10% cashback on everyday categories like McDonald's, Shopee, Grab, and even SimplyGo rides, makes it ideal for maximizing rewards on daily expenses. Consolidate spending within the bonus categories to truly maximize value.

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Supplementary Annual Fee: 1st Supplementary Card free, $98.10 for subsequent Supplementary Cards

our_takes.our-take: The UOB One Card is best for those diligent about hitting specific monthly spending tiers (S$600, S$1,000, or S$2,000) to unlock the highest cashback rates. The up to 10% cashback on everyday categories like McDonald's, Shopee, Grab, and even SimplyGo rides, makes it ideal for maximizing rewards on daily expenses. Be mindful of the S$100 late payment fee and hefty 27.8% interest on unpaid balances if you tend to miss payment deadlines. Consolidate spending within the bonus categories to truly maximize value.
our_takes.good-for:
Shoppers seeking high cashback rates at participating merchants like Shopee, Cold Storage, and 7-Eleven.
Commuters and everyday spenders aiming to maximize returns on Grab, SimplyGo, and Singapore Power utilities bills.
Consumers who consistently spend S$600 to S$2,000 monthly and want to track expenses for cashback rewards.
our_takes.things-to-note:
High interest at 27.8% annually is charged on unpaid balances; avoid carrying balances to minimise costs.
Late payment fees of S$100 are applied monthly; ensure timely payments to avoid penalties.
A 3.25% foreign transaction fee applies; use alternative cards for overseas spending to save money.
